Name: SK's Vanilla Tweaks Patch - Grains Overhaul
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[center][size=3]
This is a retexture for the [b][color=#ffd966]Grains Overhaul[/color][/b] mod to match the [b][color=#e69138]Vanilla Tweaks[/color][/b] [size=3]art style![/size]
[size=3]This mod uses [b]CMCT[/b] to read configuration settings from your installed [/size][b]Vanilla Tweaks[/b][size=3] mod,[/size]
[i]automatically syncing your preferences for saturated/desaturated visuals.[/i]
[i]- Any adjustments must be made in your main [color=#ffd966]VT[/color] config. This mod inherits those choices.[/i]
[/size][/center][size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[/size][center][size=3][b][color=#ffd966]1.[/color][/b] Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url][color=#f4f4f4].[/color]
[b][color=#ffd966]2.[/color][/b] Download [b][color=#ffd966]Grains Overhaul[/color][/b].
[b][color=#ffd966]3.[/color][/b] Download [b][color=#ffd966]Vanilla Tweaks Farming and Producer[/color][/b].
[b][color=#ffd966]4.[/color][/b] Drop everything into your Mods folder.
[b][color=#ffd966]5.[/color][/b] Run SMAPI. Done! Your grains now have that VT charm 🌾
[/size]
[size=3][b][color=#ffd966]From here you can:[/color][/b][/size]
- [size=3]Tweak your Vanilla Tweaks settings to alter the grains’ visuals.[/size]
- [size=3]Use Generic Mod Config Menu or edit config.json manually for enabling/disabling patches.[/size][/center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pOatute.png[/img]
[center]Many thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/slimerrain]slimerrain[/url] for their beautiful mod.
Much love to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]Taiyo[/url] for the incredible [b][color=#ffd966]Vanilla Tweaks[/color][/b] project, and for allowing me to build this patch around their work.
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons]Spiderbuttons[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url].

[color=#e69138][b]ConcernedApe[/b][/color] is awesome <3[/center]
